_comment: The orchestrator role's data, read the way the reviewer's is (see its
permissions.json). It falls back to the operator: an orchestrator posting as
the operator deadlocks nothing, it only loses attribution, and while the
author also falls back, the author's watches skip its posts, as they did
before roles existed. It has no `contents`: it writes no code.

why.issues: post decision-log rows and questions, edit tracking-issue bodies, claim issues for its authors
why.pull_requests: read the pull requests that resolve the issues it drives

consequence.issues: no decision-log row, question, body edit or claim can be posted
consequence.pull_requests: pull requests read as absent to any call made under the orchestrator's App
